clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: Supplier shall provide the Services described in each Statement of Work, subject to Section 8.

clauses.title: Payment Terms
clauses.text: Customer shall pay all undisputed invoices within thirty (30) days of receipt.

clauses.title: Limitation of Liability
clauses.text: Notwithstanding Section 3.1, Supplier's total liability shall be unlimited for all claims arising under this Agreement.

clauses.title: Termination for Convenience
clauses.text: Customer may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon fifteen (15) days written notice, as described in Section 14.3.
